olivia (platform): Heads up — noticed ~20 requests from tenant `acme` routing to fallback model but there are NO decision logs for them in the decision-log stream. We only have inference traces. Anyone seen gaps like this?

raj (eng-platform): Hmm. Could be sampler + header stripping at the edge. Our decision-logger sampling gate checks header fingerprinting, then applies sampling. If header gets stripped earlier, sampling can choose to drop.

kevin (sre): Also recent edge change removed some headers from whitelist (for privacy). That could remove the tenant header or debug flags. We sample ~0.5% normally. For investigations we have `X-Debug-Decision: force` to bypass sampling, but only if the header survives to the routing layer.

olivia (platform): I tried `curl -H 'X-Debug-Decision: force' -H 'X-Tenant: acme'` and still no decision log output in the stream.

nora (observability): Are you hitting cached endpoints? CDN/cache layers sometimes strip custom headers. Try adding `Cache-Control: no-cache` and a trace tag.

olivia (platform): Trying now:
```bash
curl -v -H 'X-Debug-Decision: force' -H 'X-Tenant: acme' -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -H 'X-Trace-Tag: acme-invest-1746609999' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"test"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing-config v2.11 promoted to prod by @raj — changed edge header whitelist (see changelog).

raj (eng-platform): That deploy is likely it — changed whitelist to drop `X-Debug-*` headers at the CDN for privacy reasons. We didn't think about internal debug flags.

kevin (sre): Quick mitigation: we can add a tenant-scoped override in the routing rules: if `X-Debug-Decision == force` AND `X-Tenant == acme` then set sampling = 100% and enable decision logging. I can push a canary rule.

olivia (platform): Please do. If you can include an explicit trace tag header so we can find events: `X-Trace-Tag: acme-invest-1746609999`

raj (eng-platform): Pushed canary rule to routing: `match: header('X-Debug-Decision') == 'force' && header('X-Tenant') == 'acme' -> actions: { sampling: 1.0, decision_log: verbose, match_reason: 'header-forced-sample' }` Rolling to 10% of hosts now.

nora (observability): :eyes: I see decision-log entries coming in with `X-Trace-Tag: acme-invest-1746609999`. Match reason is `header-forced-sample`. Good signal.

olivia (platform): Captured one trace. Observed prefilter stage stripped `X-User-Auth` on that path which explains fallback to generic tenant route earlier. So two things: header whitelist and prefilter header removal.

kevin (sre): I'll open PR to add `X-Debug-Decision` to the edge whitelist for tenant-scoped debug windows and add an integration test to ensure the header survives the CDN->gateway path. Also adding a console toggle in diagnostics: `Force decision logging (temporary)` which sets that header for requests from the console.

olivia (platform): Nice — can you also update the runbook with the exact steps (how to set header, how to roll the canary)? I'll add a short note about `pre-filter` stripping.

raj (eng-platform): PR created: #3547 with whitelist + test + console toggle. Merging after review. Will schedule a rollback window at 30m in case of perf/regression.

olivia (platform): :thumbsup: thanks everyone. This will help debugging for other tenants too.

kevin (sre): Follow-up: longer term we should add a small observability metric that indicates `decision-log-sample-misses` by route so we can alert when sampling is lower than expected. Filed infra ticket.

nora (observability): Filed dashboard card request and a small eval to correlate route matches vs decision-log presence.

olivia (platform): Perfect. Closing the loop here — will update tenant on debug window and summarize in runbook.
